pose: DEFICIT PUSH-UP DEEP BOTTOM on two identical 40cm-high U-shaped parallettes. Exact side profile camera at height of hands. Hands grip fore-aft rails beside LOWER RIBS at y about center of body. Lower the CHEST and SHOULDERS decisively 15cm BELOW HANDS/RAIL HEIGHT, elbows folded upward/back above torso with at least120deg flexion. Chest near floor, face points floor, toes remain floor behind. Entire head-hips-heels axis straight but lowered at shoulder end, no sag. Think very deep push-up between high handles, not shallow regular push-up. Rails along body front-to-back, each with two grounded legs and wide feet. Full body, correct hands gripping rails and no equipment intersection.

STERNUM CHIN-UP at COMPLETE TOP, side profile camera. Athlete SUSPENDED from a standard thin straight pull-up bar mounted 230cm above floor on a real grounded rack. BOTH hands UNDERHAND shoulder-width: palms face athlete's face, wrists supinated. CHEST TOUCHES BAR at LOWER STERNUM. Bar MUST cross the LOWER CHEST below nipples, not above head, not near chin. Head, neck and shoulders are ABOVE BAR. Elbows pulled FAR DOWN AND BACK past torso, maximally flexed, upper arms beside ribs. Torso reclines about45deg so lower chest meets bar, legs project forward and downward with feet60cm off floor. Absolutely no foot support or floor contact. Full body and rack, neutral neck along reclined torso axis.

45-DEGREE BACK EXTENSION GLUTE BIAS at top. Real grounded Roman chair: ordinary steel45deg frame, two hip pads below hip crease, ankle rollers and flat footplate. BOTH knees visibly SOFT/BENT about25deg, feet slightly turned out. Athlete upper back deliberately gently ROUNDED, chin tucked, ribs down and pelvis posteriorly tilted as hips extend, no lower back hyperextension. Arms crossed over chest. Clearly distinguish straight-knee neutral-spine hamstring version: BENT KNEES plus rounded upper torso. Side three-quarter with all foot contacts and padded supports mechanically coherent; full body, head looking down along torso.
